Repeated reads of already parsed JSON arrays currently open runtime handle scopes before checking the cached element. This change returns existing sparse-cache entries and descriptor-free, in-bounds, non-hole materialized slots directly. Cold construction, holes and descriptors retain the rooted fallback; growth forwarding is resolved before a materialized cached read. Outlining restores main’s 648-instruction shared array dispatcher.

On the quiet M1 against pinned main `1a9c0de6`, repeated cached reads improve about 45%, 1 MB random/fields/sequential loops improve 31–42%, and 1 MB/8 MB parse-and-scan improves about 4%. The wider controls disclose a small plain-stringify cost: +0.35% in an overlapping recheck, and +1.28% (about 0.57 ns/call) in the separate options harness. Retained-output peak RSS differs by at most 48 KiB. All 38 repeated-input parse/stringify medians remain ahead of Node 26.5.1 and Bun 1.3.14; changing-input and retained-output controls are also included.

Validation: 294 serial release JSON runtime tests, 46 behavior and 14 option comparisons, positive moved/protected GC in every scheduled fixture, four identical benchmark object files, and 18 matching native/shadow IR files. Main results were reused with exact hashes and explicit provenance. The complete evidence includes 3,756 timed trials, 622 verification records, 60 calibration trials and four separately sampled profiles.

Final PR-source qualification and required CI are pending. Local lint retains the pre-existing public benchmark freshness failure; the full native fixture check retains the same 16 unsuppressed main findings. Existing lazy-array stringify/getter failures remain recorded. No production GC core, collection policy, threshold or parse-boundary change is included.

[Complete CPU/RSS report](https://github.com/PerryTS/perry/blob/64ad28045e3ac04700f7683e8b4941f734cf66c1/benchmarks/json_performance/OUTLINED_CACHED_READ_R24.md) · [Artifact index](https://github.com/PerryTS/perry/blob/64ad28045e3ac04700f7683e8b4941f734cf66c1/benchmarks/json_performance/results/outlined-cached-read-r24-artifacts.json)
